_why.claudeMdExcludes: ~/AGENTS.md is byte-identical to ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md (6,491 B each) and Claude concatenates instruction files rather than deduplicating them, so both are loaded into every session. Codex reads ~/.codex/AGENTS.md and is unaffected. Verified: excluding a loaded instruction file drops it from the /context Memory Files table and reduces the total by its token count.
_why.expand_home: Claude does not expand '~' in claudeMdExcludes; a literal '~/AGENTS.md' silently matches nothing. The two hosts have different usernames, so the template cannot hardcode an absolute path.

_rejected.skillOverrides: Tested and does not work in the form {"<skill>": "hidden"} — the skill is still listed at its full token cost. The whole skills listing is ~2k tokens, so this lever is low value even once the correct format is known.
_rejected.enableArtifact: Setting it false produced no measurable change in a /context probe (26.2k both ways), and the setting is one-way with no undo. Not worth spending an irreversible setting for an unmeasured saving.
_rejected.deniedMcpServers/disabledMcpjsonServers: Per-project MCP scoping is unverified: it is not established that a denied server costs zero prompt tokens rather than being loaded and then blocked. Verify with a before/after /context probe before adding it here.
